concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-transfer-transactions]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace-path balance-platform tracking hub for transfer statuses, webhook/API routes and failed/refused/returned handling; booked source debit is not recipient-bank proof.
warnings: This Marketplace-path source concerns modern Adyen for Platforms balance-platform movements, not the legacy Online Payout API or Classic Platforms.
A booked source-account debit can precede recipient-bank return; there is no retry permission or bank-credit proof in this hub.
